sections.skill: Compare prices using unit prices, discounts, and sales tax

questions.prompt: A 12-ounce box of cereal costs $3.60. A 20-ounce box costs $5.40. Which is the better buy per ounce?

choices.text: The 12-ounce box, because it costs less

questions.intro: A unit price is the price per unit, such as per ounce or per item: unit price = price ÷ quantity. Comparing unit prices shows which size is the better value. (A lower unit price helps only if you will use the larger amount before it spoils.)

questions.prompt: A $64 backpack is 25% off. What is the sale price?
questions.intro: A discount is a percent taken off the price. Discount = price × rate. Sale price = price − discount, or price × (1 − rate).
questions.topic: Smart shopping: unit prices, discounts, and sales tax

misconceptions.A: Gives the discount, not the sale price

sources: New Jersey Division of Taxation: New Jersey sales tax rate is 6.625%; most clothing and footwear and most food for home consumption are exempt. (https://www.nj.gov/treasury/taxation/su_over.shtml)

questions.prompt: A taxable purchase costs $80. The sales tax rate is 6.5%. What is the TOTAL cost?
questions.intro: Sales tax is calculated by multiplying the taxable price by the tax rate. Total cost = price + tax, or price × (1 + rate). Rates differ by state and sometimes by city, and some items are exempt.
